items: Rune thrownaxe, or a friend to help enter Waterbirth Isle Dungeon
rewards: Access to the Isle of Stone
Ability to kill Basilisk Knights as a slayer task
Ability to craft and equip the Neitiznot faceguard.

st.t: Buy 2 kegs of beer from Thora in Rellekka. She will be unavailable to trade later in the quest.
Talk to Brundt in Rellekka's longhall.
Talk to Freygerd in north Rellekka.
Equip your mirror shield, then search the sand pit near Freygerd, ready to fight a basilisk youngling.
Defeat the Basilisk Youngling.
Pick up the letter.
Read the letter.
Search the rockslide west of the sand pit.
Search the boxes south of Freygerd.
Return to Freygerd with the items you found.
Return to Brundt in Rellekka's longhall. If he gives you a note, read it, then talk to him again until the cutscene plays.
Talk to Brundt south east of Rellekka, asking him all available questions.

You can get a fremennik shield from dagannoths in Waterbirth Dungeon or Bardur in Waterbirth Dungeon for 150k, or for free with the Ring of Charos(a). You'll need a friend to get there, or a rune thrownaxe and a pet rock.

i: Rune thrownaxe, or a friend to help enter Waterbirth Isle Dungeon

st.t: Talk to Baba Yaga in the chicken-legged house in the north of Lunar Isle's town.
s: I was wondering if you could help me make Lunar Glass?

st.t: Go to the Astral Altar in the south-east of Lunar Isle and use it, with the molten glass (i) and 100 astral runes in your inventory, to make some lunar glass.
Enter the mine in the north east of Lunar Isle.
Mine 3 lunar ores from the stalagmites in the area.
Smelt the lunar ore into bars at any furnace.
Make the V sigil on any anvil.
Go to the strange altar on the small peninsula south-west of Rellekka. Interact with the altar to summon the Fossegrimen, then talk to her to enchant the sigil.
Inspect the geyser north of the Mountain Camp.
s: It's for the good of the Province!

st.t: Talk to Peer the Seer south west of the Rellekka market.
Return to the geyser north of the Mountain Camp. Wear your ice gloves or smiths gloves (i), then inspect the geyser again.
Retrieve your rock from the geyser.
Use the shield parts together to make V's Shield.
Talk to Brundt south east of Rellekka with V's shield.
Talk to Brundt with 2 kegs of beer.
Return to Brundt in Rellekka's longhall.
Kill basilisks until you're told to stop.
Board the north-westernmost Fremennik boat in Rellekka, on the pier with the Waterbirth Island boat, to travel to the Island of Stone.
Talk to Brundt outside the cave entrance.

Attempt to open the door and solve the puzzle. The code is four runes from air, water, earth, fire, astral and cosmic, and a rune can appear more than once. After each guess, a green tick means a right rune in the right place, and a red tick means a right rune in the wrong place. To start, set all four slots to one rune: the green ticks show how many of that rune are in the code. Then swap runes around and use the ticks to place them. After nine wrong guesses the code changes and you start again.
Equip V's shield and keep it on for the whole fight. Then enter the door, ready to fight.
Fight Typhor, who attacks with both Melee and Magic. He is weak to crush.
Defeat the Jormungand. When the screen turns red, have your character face away from him. When frozen in rock, tap repeatedly to break out.
Watch the cutscenes. If the quest hasn't finished, talk to Brundt in Rellekka's longhall to complete it.
